events.verdict: Ilyasova (MIL) makes brief contact with Irving (BOS) with his arms, but does not fully extend or affect his ability to defend.
Tatum (BOS) makes marginal contact with his forearm against Brogdon (MIL) after his gather that does not affect the shot attempt.
Hayward (BOS) sets the screen on Middleton (MIL) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Brogdon (MIL) makes incidental contact with Hayward (BOS) as he attempts to steal the pass.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) dislodges Smart (BOS) during rebounding.
Smart (BOS) firms up in a screening position in Bledsoe's (MIL) path and absorbs the contact.
Bledsoe (MIL) and Irving (BOS) make incidental contact with each other as they attempt to gain control of the rebound.
Middleton (MIL) goes to, not through, Irving's (BOS) space as he backs him down in the post.
Irving (BOS) places a legal hand against Middleton (MIL) as he defends him in the post and he cleanly dislodges the ball.
LLS and LAR show that Irving (BOS) places his left arm around Middleton's (MIL) hip and pulls him, affecting his ability to control the loose ball.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: Middleton (MIL) is out of bounds while in possession of the ball.
Middleton (MIL) briefly places his arm to the front of Tatum (BOS), but the contact is marginal and does not affect his SQBR.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) splits his feet at the start of the dribble.
Horford (BOS) moves along Antetokounmpo's (MIL) path and makes incidental arm contact that does not affect his SQBR during the drive.
Ilyasova (MIL) makes incidental contact with Horford (BOS) that does not affect his ability to grab the rebound.
Bledsoe (MIL) commits a take foul on Morris (BOS).
[Observable in enhanced video] Tatum (BOS) lifts his pivot foot prior to the start of his dribble.
Brogdon (MIL) reaches in and makes marginal contact with Tatum (BOS) as he attempts to dribble out of the double team.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) makes incidental hand-on-ball contact with Tatum (BOS).
Tatum (BOS) initiates the contact to the body with Bledsoe (MIL) that affects his SQBR.
Horford (BOS) establishes himself in a screening position outside of Bledsoe's (MIL) path. He extends his arms towards Bledsoe, but Bledsoe avoids the contact.
Ilyasova (MIL) commits a take foul on Irving (BOS).
Bledsoe (MIL) briefly places his off-arm against Irving's (BOS) body but does not extend it and dislodge him from his legal guarding position.
Irving (BOS) moves along Bledsoe's (MIL) path during the drive and makes marginal contact that does not affect his SQBR.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) makes incidental contact with Smart (BOS) as he leaves his feet to receive the pass.
Smart (BOS) makes contact with Antetokounmpo's (MIL) wrist during his upward shooting motion.
Middleton (MIL) commits a take foul on Horford (BOS).
